result:
I passed round 229 (CALM-2a). All 15 acceptance rows were checked in real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. I found one Low bug. The full suite, build, `verify` and e2e smoke are the root gate's rows; I didn't run or claim them.

**What I checked and saw:**
- **Scope:** HEAD is `499c821` and only the 15 granted files plus doc 178 changed. All the hash lists match and the protected auth files are unchanged. The test changes match B's draft diff plus the new test cases.
- **Unit tests:** the 8 listed test files pass, 129/129, and the four new cases exist.
- **Removed text:** I compared against a copy of HEAD running on its own server on the same machine. Exactly the 7 required text entries are gone in every state and viewport, and nothing new appears. B's earlier capture shows a few extra differences, but those come from when the page was still loading.
- **Layout:** the only boxes that moved are the now-empty caption and the new empty monitor, which sits exactly on the video box. The caption row stays 16 px, and the Overview and footer did not move.
- **Loop button:**
  - With no selection it is disabled and its tooltip says "Loop: make a time selection first (Ctrl+L)".
  - With a time selection it is enabled and says "Loop the time selection (Ctrl+L)".
  - With a loop but no selection it says "Loop on / off (Ctrl+L)".
  - Ctrl+L still turns the loop on.
  - Headless Chromium doesn't draw native tooltips, so I checked the attribute rather than a screenshot.
- **Moved facts still reachable:**
  - The BPM tooltip and the status after setting 120 BPM both still say "audio is not stretched".
  - The Overview's labels are unchanged.
  - The video track's Mute, Solo and Volume tooltips name "Original video sound", including at the smallest unfolded height (52 px).
- **Video:** the empty monitor is a dark box with no text. With my small synthetic test video loaded, the frame shows and the caption is exactly the file name. In a gap the caption is empty and "No video · 00:10.000" shows. Expanding, dragging, returning and closing the floating video still work.
- **Auth and export:** a new session without credentials opens the demo with no saved login. The protected page still says "Sign in required" and the token endpoint returns 401. The exported WAV is 24-bit, 48 kHz, stereo, and its loudness per 10-second segment is identical to round 228.

**Findings for B:**
- **C-R229-01 (Low):** the reason Loop is unavailable now lives only on a disabled button. Mouse users see it on hover and screen readers get it, but Tab never reaches the button, so keyboard-only users can't read it. The task required this and Zoom-to-selection already works the same way, so I suggest fixing it with DUX-R-4(b).
- **Escape doesn't clear a time selection,** so the task's recipe for the last loop state doesn't work. HEAD behaves the same, so this round didn't cause it. I used a click on an empty lane instead. I didn't check what Ableton does on Escape, so it's a note, not a bug.
- **Conflicting rules:** the "the search for deleted names finds nothing" rule clashes with the new test that checks those names are absent. I let the test win; B should pick one wording for CALM-2b and CALM-3.

Ableton comparison: I re-read manual chapter 6. The Overview having no label matches Live. The other five differences are the ones B already listed.

The temporary HEAD server is stopped, the main server is still up, and the store tree and `node_modules` are untouched.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-229.md
- c-round-229.json
- c-round-229/ (evidence)
